column1: # local-ci-inputs.tsv — conservative consumed-input roots for local-ci.sh
# The first column is a stable scope name.  The second is an engine-relative
# file or directory.  A scope is hashed as sorted path + file-digest records,
# including untracked files under the declared directories.  The mapping is
# intentionally conservative: an extra rerun is safe; skipping a consumer of
# changed bytes is not.  check.sh remains one stateful, fail-fast transaction,
# so the driver uses these scopes to decide whether to rerun the transaction,
# while recording the applicable scope hash beside every logical slot.
